
```jsx
import { CxAccordionItem } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxAccordionItem from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/accordion/CxAccordionItem'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **itemKey** | Item key. | `string` \| `number` \| `undefined` | - |
